Vitale claims Dolan’s at 9:00 PM, which is when the ice being brought in was on. Asked about it, Vitale cannot say that the iceman dropped a block on the step and it went in three — and everybody who was there can.

The woman who keeps the child says it straight out: Vitale was at Kaplan’s from 9:00 PM, the same as every week, and left with the same face as always.

The man behind the counter at Dolan’s knows exactly: Mulcahy was on the same stool from 9:00 PM to 9:30 PM and was in no condition to walk anywhere, let alone do this.
Moretti on Thorndike: Thorndike and Ashby were heard at the walk-up, and one of them was doing all the talking.
An envelope at the walk-up with nothing in it, addressed in Ashby’s hand to no one.
Ashby’s bank book settles it: four payments, and Thorndike at the walk-up from 7:30 PM to 8:00 PM collecting the fifth. It is extortion, and an extortionist wants Ashby alive.
